scope: New synthetic fixtures only; no historical or private source arrays/readers
primary_requirements: Typed checkpoint JSON roundtrip restores the entire array, ordered reader and reference for every trial
Known initial state plus full ordered journal reproduces every final state
Reversed journal with negated counts restores every initial state
Independent coordinate-dictionary oracle agrees on every trace step and primitive/reference/count case
Mutated array, reader and reference fail checksum validation without digest recomputation
Synthetic equal-observation/different-state example is retained and later distinguished by a declared reader shift
descriptive_controls: Journal truncation: report differences and accidental agreements rather than require all corruptions to differ
Reversed journal order: report differences and accidental agreements
Independent shuffled order: report differences and accidental agreements
Recomputed digest on changed state: accepted as a well-formed different state, demonstrating lack of authenticity
Distinct commuting journals may have the same endpoint
